```{=html}
<div class="screen-only">
  <b>WS-17-dispatch-brief-template</b> &middot; review copy &middot; declared format <b>A4 portrait</b> &middot;
  4 sheet(s). Each white page below is one physical sheet at true size.
  Anything spilling past a page edge onto this grey background is a layout defect.
</div>

<!-- ============================ SHEET 1 ============================== -->
<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Agent Dispatch Brief Template and Quality Check</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A reusable dispatch brief plus a pre-flight quality check &mdash; Part A: the brief, one per dispatch.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-17-dispatch-brief-template</b><br>
      Pack Z - Second wave: the practitioner kit<br>
      fill order <b>20</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>
      audience <b>practitioner</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>Multi-Agent Orchestration</b>, <i>Concrete Dispatch: What It Actually Looks Like</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook/ch17-multi-agent-orchestration.qmd</code> L90-132 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch17-multi-agent-orchestration.html#sec-multi-agent-dispatch-example">#sec-multi-agent-dispatch-example</a>
    <br>"The Domain Teams pattern describes structure. Here is what a dispatch actually"
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Fill the five blocks of a dispatch: the instruction files loaded (and only those), the exclusively owned file list,
    the committed reference the agent must read rather than a description of it, the explicit constraints
    (do-not-modify list, signatures, behavior preservation), and the verification command the agent runs before
    reporting done. Then tick the five quality criteria on Part B before dispatching. Part A is one brief for one
    real task. Draws on <code>WS-17-agent-team-charter</code> (rows 2 and 4) and keys to
    <code>WS-18-wave-decomposition-plan</code> (row 1).
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Part A &mdash; the dispatch brief
      <span class="ws-block-note">one filled instance per dispatch &middot; rows A1-A8 (A9-A15 overleaf)</span></h2>

    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:6%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:38%"><col style="width:36%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">1</span></td>
          <td><b>A1 Dispatch ID, wave, agent</b></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">derived</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td>
          <td><b>A2 Agent team</b><br><small>Chosen from the team charter; determines which instruction files are legitimate at A4.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">ch17 L77-86</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">3</span></td>
          <td><b>A3 Transformation rule, one sentence</b><br><small>State it as a transformation, not a goal.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Worked instance: "Migrate the following files from print-based output to the structured logger established in Wave 0."<span class="prior-src">ch17 L104-105</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">4</span></td>
          <td><b>A4 Instruction files loaded</b><br><small>The actual paths, from the team's charter.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Worked instance: a project-wide conventions file always loaded, plus one integration-specific file. Constraint: two instruction files, not twelve.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L97-98, L128</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">5</span></td>
          <td><b>A5 Exclusively owned file list</b><br><small>Explicit paths. Not a directory, not a glob.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Worked instance: three named command modules, with "exclusive ownership this wave" stated in the prompt.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L108-111, L126</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">6</span></td>
          <td><b>A6 Committed reference</b><br><small>The artefact, its path, and evidence it is committed.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Worked instance: a factory pattern in a named source file, "committed and tested"; the prompt says "established in Wave 0" so the agent reads real code.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L105-106, L127</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">7</span></td>
          <td><b>A7 Structural context</b><br><small>This task's structural facts, or "none for this task".</small></td>
          <td class="prior">The category: module boundaries, dependency relationships, file organisation conventions &mdash; what a new function should be named, where it should live, which existing patterns it follows.<span class="prior-src">ch10 L52</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">8</span></td>
          <td><b>A8 Constraint context</b><br><small>This task's constraints.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">The category: what the agent must not do, which files are off-limits, which behavioural contracts must be preserved. Worked constraint block: do not modify any file outside the list; do not change function signatures or public APIs; preserve all existing behaviour; use the named helpers and see the named examples file.<span class="prior-src">ch10 L53; ch17 L113-118</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot">
    <div>WS-17-dispatch-brief-template &middot; The Agentic SDLC Handbook worksheet kit &middot; sheet 1 of 4</div>
    <div>Filled by <span style="display:inline-block;width:40mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span>
      &nbsp; Date <span style="display:inline-block;width:24mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span></div>
  </div>

</div>
<!-- ========================== END SHEET 1 ============================ -->

<!-- ============================ SHEET 2 ============================== -->
<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Agent Dispatch Brief Template and Quality Check</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">Part A, continued &mdash; context, exclusions, verification, escalation, and the calibration pair.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-17-dispatch-brief-template</b><br>
      Pack Z - Second wave: the practitioner kit<br>
      fill order <b>20</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>
      audience <b>practitioner</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Part A &mdash; the dispatch brief, continued
      <span class="ws-block-note">rows A9-A15</span></h2>

    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:6%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:38%"><col style="width:36%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">9</span></td>
          <td><b>A9 Domain context</b><br><small>This task's domain facts, or an explicit "none for this task". A blank must be a decision, not an oversight.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">The category: business logic, edge cases, the implicit rules that exist in the team's understanding but not in the code &mdash; why a seemingly redundant check exists, why error messages are worded as they are.<span class="prior-src">ch10 L54</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">10</span></td>
          <td><b>A10 Explicit exclusions</b><br><small>Anything off-limits beyond the complement of A5.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Pre-printed: "Do NOT modify any file not in this list" is the one-file-one-agent rule stated in the agent's own terms.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L114, L130</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">11</span></td>
          <td><b>A11 Verification command the agent runs before reporting done</b><br><small>The actual command, with arguments.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Worked instance: a scoped test command with a fail-fast flag, followed by "Fix any failures before reporting done."<span class="prior-src">ch17 L120-121, L129</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">12</span></td>
          <td><b>A12 Escalation instruction</b><br><small>What this agent does when it cannot proceed, and to whom.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Self-validation before reporting completion is L1 self-heal; anything the agent cannot resolve routes up the ladder.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L129; ch17 L344-349</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">13</span></td>
          <td><b>A13 Dispatched by, date</b></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">org</span></td>
          <td class="fill">
            <span class="f-owner"></span>
            <div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">14</span></td>
          <td><b>A14 Calibration pair &mdash; the bad specification</b><br><small>The team's own bad spec, for its own codebase.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Worked instance: a one-line migration rule that sounds precise until the agent meets a call that was a deliberate workaround, migrates it dutifully, and the regression surfaces weeks later under load.<span class="prior-src">ch10 L46-47</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box lg"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">15</span></td>
          <td><b>A15 Calibration pair &mdash; the good specification</b><br><small>The team's own good spec, same transformation.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Worked instance: the same rule plus the named exception, the reason for it, and the marker the agent must leave behind &mdash; requiring knowledge of the codebase the agent cannot infer.<span class="prior-src">ch10 L48</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box lg"></span></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot">
    <div>WS-17-dispatch-brief-template &middot; The Agentic SDLC Handbook worksheet kit &middot; sheet 2 of 4</div>
    <div>Filled by <span style="display:inline-block;width:40mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span>
      &nbsp; Date <span style="display:inline-block;width:24mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span></div>
  </div>

</div>
<!-- ========================== END SHEET 2 ============================ -->

<!-- ============================ SHEET 3 ============================== -->
<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Agent Dispatch Brief Template and Quality Check</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">Part B &mdash; the pre-flight check. Keep this card at the orchestrator's desk; it gates the dispatch.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-17-dispatch-brief-template</b><br>
      Pack Z - Second wave: the practitioner kit<br>
      fill order <b>20</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>
      audience <b>practitioner</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Before you dispatch, tick each of the five criteria against the brief you filled in Part A. Do not tick a box
    you have not checked. Then record the gate at the foot of the card: if any box is empty, the dispatch is
    blocked, and the card records the block, not just the release.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Part B &mdash; pre-flight check
      <span class="ws-block-note">five checkboxes &middot; dispatch gate</span></h2>

    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:6%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:40%"><col style="width:32%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Criterion</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">1</span></td>
          <td><b>B1 Exclusive file list confirmed</b><br><small>Checked against the wave's partition.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">"The agent knows exactly which files it owns. No ambiguity, no overlap with other agents in this wave."<span class="prior-src">ch17 L126</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>confirmed</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td>
          <td><b>B2 Committed reference confirmed</b></td>
          <td class="prior">"The agent reads the actual committed code, not a description of what it should look like."<span class="prior-src">ch17 L127</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>confirmed</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">3</span></td>
          <td><b>B3 Scoped instructions confirmed</b></td>
          <td class="prior">"Two instruction files, not twelve." Nothing irrelevant to this task is carried.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L128</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>confirmed</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">4</span></td>
          <td><b>B4 Built-in validation confirmed</b></td>
          <td class="prior">"The prompt ends with a test command. The agent self-validates before reporting completion."<span class="prior-src">ch17 L129</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>confirmed</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">5</span></td>
          <td><b>B5 Explicit constraints confirmed</b></td>
          <td class="prior">The one-file-one-agent rule is stated in the agent's own terms inside the prompt.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L130</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>confirmed</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">6</span></td>
          <td><b>Dispatch gate</b><br><small>Blocked until B1-B5 are all ticked. Record the block, not just the release.</small></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">ch17 L124-130</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="B1 &and; B2 &and; B3 &and; B4 &and; B5 ticked &rarr; released; otherwise BLOCKED"></span></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot-quote">
    "The orchestrator dispatches this prompt in a fresh session, monitors for completion or escalation, and moves to the next dispatch." (ch17 L132)
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot">
    <div>WS-17-dispatch-brief-template &middot; The Agentic SDLC Handbook worksheet kit &middot; sheet 3 of 4</div>
    <div>Filled by <span style="display:inline-block;width:40mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span>
      &nbsp; Date <span style="display:inline-block;width:24mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span></div>
  </div>

</div>
<!-- ========================== END SHEET 3 ============================ -->

<!-- ============================ SHEET 4 ============================== -->
<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Agent Dispatch Brief Template and Quality Check</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">Part C &mdash; the first-run record. One sheet per person, filled at the desk.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-17-dispatch-brief-template</b><br>
      Pack Z - Second wave: the practitioner kit<br>
      fill order <b>20</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>
      audience <b>practitioner</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Take one real ticket. After your own first real dispatch, fill one row per step, yourself, at the desk. A grid
    filled by someone else on your behalf is worthless. For every step, write the elapsed time, the role you were
    in, whether you dispatched it or typed it by hand, and &mdash; the column that matters &mdash; which context
    file you improved as a result. Then copy every column-4 entry into the instruction-file edit list at the foot.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Part C &mdash; what each column means
      <span class="ws-block-note">printed by the book &middot; do not write here</span></h2>

    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:6%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:58%"><col style="width:16%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Column</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Source</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"></td><td><b>C1 Elapsed time</b></td>
          <td class="locked">Shape only: 0:00, 0:04, 0:08, &hellip;</td><td class="locked">ch10 L150-172</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"></td><td><b>C2 Role you were in</b></td>
          <td class="locked">Architect / Reviewer / Escalation handler &mdash; the three roles. (One-line definitions are those printed in the book's first-day section, ch10 L150-172.)</td><td class="locked">ch10 L150-172</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"></td><td><b>C3 Dispatched or typed by hand</b></td>
          <td class="locked">Worked instance: the middleware was dispatched, the three-line wiring was typed, the two-line policy fix was typed rather than re-dispatched because the specification-to-code ratio would have been absurd.</td><td class="locked">ch10 L150-172</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"></td><td><b>C4 Which context file was improved as a result</b></td>
          <td class="locked">Worked instance: a fail-closed policy added to the middleware instruction file; a warning against sleep-based assertions added to the test instruction file.</td><td class="locked">ch10 L150-172</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"></td><td><b>C5 Outcome of the step</b></td>
          <td class="locked">&mdash;</td><td class="locked">org</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Part C &mdash; the first-run grid
      <span class="ws-block-note">one row per step &middot; one grid per person</span></h2>

    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:11%"><col style="width:19%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:25%"><col style="width:25%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th>C1 Elapsed</th><th>C2 Role</th><th>C3 Dispatched / typed</th><th>C4 Context file improved (path + line added)</th><th>C5 Outcome</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Architect</span><span class="opt">Reviewer</span><span class="opt">Escalation handler</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">dispatched</span><span class="opt">typed</span><span class="opt">both</span></div><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Architect</span><span class="opt">Reviewer</span><span class="opt">Escalation handler</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">dispatched</span><span class="opt">typed</span><span class="opt">both</span></div><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Architect</span><span class="opt">Reviewer</span><span class="opt">Escalation handler</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">dispatched</span><span class="opt">typed</span><span class="opt">both</span></div><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Architect</span><span class="opt">Reviewer</span><span class="opt">Escalation handler</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">dispatched</span><span class="opt">typed</span><span class="opt">both</span></div><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Architect</span><span class="opt">Reviewer</span><span class="opt">Escalation handler</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">dispatched</span><span class="opt">typed</span><span class="opt">both</span></div><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="ours-label">Instruction-file edit list &mdash; every C4 entry collated: the evidence that the improvement loop actually closes</div>
    <span class="f-computed" data-formula="all non-empty C4 entries, one per line"></span>
    <span class="f-box"></span>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot">
    <div>WS-17-dispatch-brief-template &middot; The Agentic SDLC Handbook worksheet kit &middot; sheet 4 of 4</div>
    <div>Filled by <span style="display:inline-block;width:40mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span>
      &nbsp; Date <span style="display:inline-block;width:24mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span></div>

</div>
```
